---
engine: knitr
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: false
    output-file: Barbone-CV.pdf
    papersize: us-letter
    margin: 
      x: "0.5in"
      y: "0.5in"
    footer: true
    numbering: true
    template-partials:
      - cv/typst-template.typ
execute:
  echo: false
params:
  metadata_file: _metadata.yaml
  csl_file: csl/apa-cv.csl
  bib_publications: bib/publications.bib
  bib_thesis: bib/thesis.bib
  bib_posters_cogstate: bib/posters_cogstate.bib
  bib_posters_cog: bib/posters_cog.bib
  bib_posters_madrigal: bib/posters_madrigal.bib
  bib_posters_signant: bib/posters_signant.bib
  bib_posters_wcupa: bib/posters_wcupa.bib
  bib_packages: bib/packages.bib
---

```{r}
#| label: fn
devtools::load_all(quiet = TRUE)

experience_group_item <- function(company, items) {
  # list is newest-first; use first non-empty location as most recent location
  locations <- vapply(
    items,
    \(x) entry_location(x),
    NA_character_
  )
  nz <- which(nzchar(trimws(locations)))
  recent_location <- if (length(nz) > 0) locations[nz[1]] else ""

  out <- c(
    "  (",
    sprintf("    org: %s,", to_typst_content(company)),
    sprintf("    location: %s,", to_typst_content(recent_location)),
    "    roles: ("
  )

  for (item in items) {
    bullets <- bullet_items(item$accomplishments)

    out <- c(
      out,
      "      (",
      sprintf("        role: %s,", to_typst_content(entry_role(item))),
      sprintf("        dates: %s,", to_typst_content(entry_dates(item))),
      "        bullets: ("
    )

    for (b in bullets) {
      out <- c(out, paste0("          ", to_typst_content(b), ","))
    }

    out <- c(out, "        ),", "      ),")
  }

  c(out, "    ),", "  ),")
}

education_item <- function(item) {
  bullets <- bullet_items(item$details)

  out <- c(
    "  (",
    sprintf("    org: %s,", to_typst_content(entry_org(item))),
    sprintf("    credential: %s,", to_typst_content(entry_credential(item))),
    sprintf("    location: %s,", to_typst_content(entry_location(item))),
    sprintf("    dates: %s,", to_typst_content(entry_dates(item))),
    "    bullets: ("
  )

  for (b in bullets) {
    out <- c(out, paste0("      ", to_typst_content(b), ","))
  }

  c(out, "    ),", "  ),")
}

skills_item <- function(item) {
  c(
    "  (",
    sprintf("    name: %s,", to_typst_content(item$name)),
    sprintf("    details: %s,", to_typst_content(item$details)),
    "  ),"
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: data
meta <- yaml::read_yaml(params$metadata_file)
```

```{=typst}
#import "cv/typst-template.typ": *
```

```{r}
#| label: meta
#| results: asis
meta_lines <- c(
  "// Auto-generated from YAML sources. Do not edit manually.",
  sprintf("#let cv_given = %s", typst_string(meta$given)),
  sprintf("#let cv_surname = %s", typst_string(meta$surname)),
  sprintf("#let cv_location = %s", typst_string(meta$location)),
  sprintf("#let cv_phone = %s", typst_string(meta$phone)),
  sprintf(
    "#let cv_phone_display = %s",
    typst_string(meta$phone_display %||% meta$phone)
  ),
  sprintf("#let cv_email = %s", typst_string(meta$email)),
  sprintf("#let cv_web = %s", typst_string(meta$web)),
  sprintf("#let cv_github = %s", typst_string(meta$github)),
  sprintf("#let cv_linkedin = %s", typst_string(meta$linkedin)),
  sprintf(
    "#let cv_professional_title = %s",
    typst_string(meta$professional_title)
  ),
  sprintf("#let cv_summary_short = %s", typst_string(meta$summary_short))
)
emit_typst_chunk(meta_lines)
```

```{r}
#| label: experience
#| results: asis
experience <- sort_experience(meta$experience)
experience_lines <- c("#let experience_data = (")

companies <- vapply(experience, \(i) entry_org(i), NA_character_)
experience_by_company <- split(experience, factor(companies, unique(companies)))

for (company in names(experience_by_company)) {
  items <- experience_by_company[[company]]
  experience_lines <- c(experience_lines, experience_group_item(company, items))
}
experience_lines <- c(experience_lines, ")")
emit_typst_chunk(experience_lines)
```

```{r}
#| label: education
#| results: asis
education_lines <- c("#let education_data = (")

for (i in seq_along(meta$education)) {
  item <- meta$education[[i]]
  education_lines <- c(education_lines, education_item(item))
}
education_lines <- c(education_lines, ")")
emit_typst_chunk(education_lines)
```

#| label: papers

  list(
    title = "Peer Reviewed Publications",

  ),

    title = "Master's Thesis",
    items = format_refs_apa(params$bib_thesis, params$csl_file)

)
paper_groups_lines <- c(sprintf(

emit_typst_chunk(paper_groups_lines)
